# Board of Library Trustees Meeting Minutes

## Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 3:00 PM

The meeting on August 12, 2026, was called to order at 3:00 PM by Joanne Geneva

Present:

Voting Members: Joanne Geneva – Chair, Peggy Blume – Secretary, Sharon McCann-Kling – Member At Large

Non-Voting Members: Jim McQueen – Library Director, Deb Griffin- Youth Services Librarian

The Trustees reviewed the minutes of the meeting held on July 14, 2026. Joanne noted that the word voted should be changed to motioned to adjourn the July meeting. Joanne made a motion to accept the minutes with the correction. Sharon seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously.

## Sutton Free Public Library

## Youth Services Librarian Report

## Meeting: July 14 2026 3pm

**Summer Reading 2026:** (winners being contacted by email August 9 - 15)

From our last report on July 14 -

KIDS - 60 active, 86 registered, 25,910 minutes read

TEEN - 22 active, 40 registered, 16,116 minutes read

As of August 10 - (grand totals)

KIDS - 81 active, 106 registered, 75,578 minutes read

TEEN - 32 active, 46 registered, 45,226 minutes read

**Programming:**

For the month of August, we have 6 activities on the calendar, with some activities repeating throughout the month. We are continuing with our new activities introduced last month - Me & My Mini, Early Reader Book Club, and Knit-Wits Club. We did receive the Acoustic Rooster themed kits from WGBH. Those will be transitioning into our 1000 Books Before Kindergarten program (which is something that I will be reviewing & updating). We've continued with the passive programming "This or That" question that changes each week. We've had great participation and routinely get well over 100 each question. The current question is about sharks - baby shark vs Bruce from Finding Nemo.

**Collection Development:**

I have slowly begun wedding Juvenile picture books and board books. My hope is that when weeding is complete in the Youth area, we will be able to carve out a space for a Juvenile Library of Things (as I mentioned last month).

*[Signature: Peggy Blume]*

**Meetings:**

- August 18: Meeting with Theresa, the Children's/Young Adult Librarian at the Millbury Public Library, regarding a Dinovember collaboration

**Other:**

- To Do: begin professional development through Massachusetts Library System learning pathways
- To Do: add to Tween and Teen programming
- Continued work using social media to promote our programs and events
- To Do: excited to get back into the Meeting Room to complete the reorganization of the cabinets
- To Do: cleaning out the back closet in hopes to use space more efficiently
- To Do: meet with the elementary level Librarians in the Sutton Public Schools
- Continued investigation and communication with various facilitators about scheduling upcoming programs/activities

## Sutton Free Public Library

## Director's Report

## August 2026

**Adult Programming:**

Please see attached report for July 2026 program statistics. Adult programs scheduled for August include: Adult Coloring Club, Board Game Night, afternoon and evening book groups, Cribbage Club, Knots and Thoughts Fiber Club, Sci-Fi and Fantasy Book Group, Steady and Strong Yoga, and Writing Group.

**Adult Summer Reading;**

Summer Reading ended August 8. The following table shows adult participation this year.

| Measure | Count |
|---|---|
| Readers Registered | 117 |
| Readers Who Logged Minutes | 94 |
| Readers Who Completed Activities | 19 |
| Activities Completed | 19 |
| Readers Who Wrote Reviews | 6 |
| Reviews Written | 25 |
| Badges Earned | 3,492 |
| Minutes Logged | 201,449 |

## FY 2027 State Aid:

I submitted the Annual Report Information Survey (ARIS) on August 3, and the signature page, signed by Joanne and me, on August 5. That portion of the FY 2027 State Aid cycle is now complete for Sutton. The Financial Report opened August 3 and closes October 2, the same day State Aid applications are due. I attended Financial Report training on August 7.

***Jim reviewed the budget with the Trustees. He noted that the summer reading program expense for the performance by Erica Peters was funded by the Cultural Council and should not be included in the gifts budget. He requested the accounting dept to make that adjustment.***

***The program statistics were reviewed. Joanne asked what the category self-directed included. Jim explained programs such as the scavenger hunt, the coloring sheets for children and the This or That game. Sharon asked about yoga as an offsite program. Jim explained that it was held on the 3rd floor of Town Hall, not in the library.***

**Strategic Planning Update:**

Jim explained that the working group were currently looking for individuals and groups to take part in the scheduled focus group meetings on September 1. He explained that anyone can take part and register online. The groups will be capped at 25 participants per session. Sharon asked if the sessions could be watched on cable TV. Jim and Joanne said they would not be televised.

The next meeting of the Library Board of Trustees will be held September 9 at 3:00 PM.

Joanne made a motion to adjourn the meeting at 3:49. Sharon seconded the motion. The motion passed unanimously.
